events.title: Tupac Shakur: A Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries on September 13.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years since that fateful night in Las Vegas, the music world still feels the void left by Tupac Shakur. His influence remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: More than five decades on, Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire. A true original, gone too soon.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, was originally released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: That Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since 'Abbey Road' first graced our turntables. What's your go-to track from this timeless Beatles masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: American-British singer-songwriter Chrissie Hynde, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting continue to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, famed as the lead vocalist of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, whose swagger and vocals defined a generation.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975, following its initial US release in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than five decades on, John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: The revolutionary first-generation Apple iPod, which transformed how we listen to music, was officially launched on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It completely changed the game, didn't it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his enduring legacy of espionage and style.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for his work with Monty Python and 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since 'The White Album' dropped. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showcased the individual brilliance of The Beatles. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Unforgettable Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and unparalleled stage presence remain as powerful as ever. A true rock icon.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Innovation
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. The Beatles' innovative album continues to influence music to this day.
